name: Georgy Malenkov
role: Leader of the Soviet Union from 1953 to 1955
contribution: A Soviet politician who succeeded Joseph Stalin as Premier and the overall leader of the Soviet Union in March 1953.
legacy: This person supervised the takeover of German V2 missile industry that was moved from Peenemünde to Moscow for further development that resulted in the building of Vostok missiles and orbiting Sputnik a few years later.

checks.lead: Georgy Maximilianovich Malenkov (8 January 1902 [O.S. 26 December 1901] – 14 January 1988) was a Soviet politician who succeeded Joseph Stalin as Premier and the overall leader of the Soviet Union in March 1953. Shortly thereafter, Malenkov entered into a power struggle with the party's First Secretary, Nikita Khrushchev, which culminated in his removal from the premiership in 1955 as well as the Central Committee Presidium in 1957.
